description: Visual GUI automation page (UIBridgeStateMachinePage) — a comprehensive state machine builder and explorer backed by the UI Bridge SDK. The page hosts 8 tabs: Discovery (4-phase workflow to build a config from live exploration, recording, or static source analysis), Graph Editor (interactive ReactFlow canvas with side panels), State View, Transitions (with runtime permitted/blocked introspection), Diagram (Mermaid rendering), Pathfinding, Exploration Results (automated verification viewer), and Export. All config-dependent tabs show an empty-state message until a configuration is selected from the header dropdown. When a config is active, an ObservationsPanel above the tabs shows drift-fit scores, re-derivation controls, and the invalidation log for the observation-driven state definition pipeline.

groups.description: A ReactFlow-based interactive canvas displaying the state machine as a directed graph. When a config is loaded, states appear as nodes and transitions as edges. An 'Add Transition' FAB overlays the top-left of the canvas. Clicking a state opens the StateDetailPanel side panel on the right; clicking a transition opens the TransitionEditor. Element drag creates transitions (plain drag) or moves elements between states (Alt+drag). A pathfinding highlight overlays a color-coded traversal path on matching edges.

groups.description: Each selected state in the graph side panel shows a ProvenanceBadge indicating its lifecycle status in the observation-driven pipeline. 'observed' (green) has real captured observations; 'ai-fallback' (yellow) was recently invalidated and is being rebuilt; 'ai-generated' (gray) has no discovery artifact match. Metadata shows observation count and age for observed, or invalidation age for ai-fallback.
